mapper.sql: a.id AS id, a.asset_category_value_id AS asset_category_value_id, a.department_id AS department_id, a.code AS code, a.name AS name, asset_category.code AS asset_category_code, asset_category.name AS asset_category_name, department.name AS department_name, a.status_code AS status_code, asset_status.name AS status_name, a.note AS note, a.created_at AS created_at, a.updated_at AS updated_at

INNER JOIN generic_master asset_category_master ON asset_category_master.code = 'ASSET_CATEGORY' AND asset_category_master.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN generic_master_values asset_category ON asset_category.id = a.asset_category_value_id AND asset_category.generic_master_id = asset_category_master.id AND asset_category.company_id = a.company_id AND asset_category.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN departments department ON department.id = a.department_id AND department.company_id = a.company_id AND department.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN common_master asset_status_master ON asset_status_master.code = 'ASSET_STATUS' AND asset_status_master.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN common_master_values asset_status ON asset_status.common_master_id = asset_status_master.id AND asset_status.code = a.status_code AND asset_status.is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT asset_category.id AS id, asset_category.code AS code, asset_category.name AS name FROM generic_master asset_category_master INNER JOIN generic_master_values asset_category ON asset_category.generic_master_id = asset_category_master.id AND asset_category.company_id = #{companyId} AND asset_category.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE asset_category_master.code = 'ASSET_CATEGORY' AND asset_category_master.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY asset_category.sort_order ASC, asset_category.id ASC

SELECT department.id AS id, department.code AS code, department.name AS name FROM departments department WHERE department.company_id = #{companyId} AND department.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY department.code ASC, department.id ASC

SELECT asset_status.code AS code, asset_status.name AS name FROM common_master asset_status_master INNER JOIN common_master_values asset_status ON asset_status.common_master_id = asset_status_master.id AND asset_status.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE asset_status_master.code = 'ASSET_STATUS' AND asset_status_master.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY asset_status.sort_order ASC, asset_status.id ASC

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM generic_master asset_category_master INNER JOIN generic_master_values asset_category ON asset_category.generic_master_id = asset_category_master.id AND asset_category.company_id = #{companyId} AND asset_category.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE asset_category_master.code = 'ASSET_CATEGORY' AND asset_category_master.is_deleted = FALSE AND asset_category.id = #{assetCategoryValueId} )

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM common_master asset_status_master INNER JOIN common_master_values asset_status ON asset_status.common_master_id = asset_status_master.id AND asset_status.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE asset_status_master.code = 'ASSET_STATUS' AND asset_status_master.is_deleted = FALSE AND asset_status.code = #{statusCode} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assets ( company_id, asset_category_value_id, department_id, code, name, status_code, note, is_deleted, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{assetCategoryValueId}, #{departmentId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{statusCode}, #{note}, FALSE, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE assets SET asset_category_value_id = #{assetCategoryValueId}, department_id = #{departmentId}, code = #{code}, name = #{name}, status_code = #{statusCode}, note = #{note}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
